meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码结构搜索并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要跨文件修改同一类代码结构。
copy.tagline_en: Search code by syntax shape and rewrite it in bulk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to modify the same kind of code structure across files.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能按代码结构（语法树）而不是文本搜索和改写代码，支持 25 种语言。可以找出特定形状的函数、调用、类或导入，执行批量替换（如 console.log→logger.info），并支持预览后应用。
howto.when: 当用户要求按代码结构查找或改写代码（如查找特定形状的函数、重写 console.log、去除 as any 等）时触发。纯文本搜索（字符串、注释、文件名）不触发。

say.text: 把项目里所有 console.log(x) 改成 logger.info(x)
找到所有接收 Request 参数的函数
去掉所有 as any 类型断言

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search and rewrite code based on syntax tree structure (AST) rather than plain text, across 25 languages. It can find functions, calls, classes, or imports matching a shape, apply deterministic transforms (e.g., console.log → logger.info), and preview before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to find or rewrite code based on structure (e.g., find functions of a shape, rewrite console.log, strip as any). Not triggered for plain-text search (string contents, comments, filenames).

say_en.text: Replace all console.log(x) with logger.info(x) in the project.
Find all functions that take a Request parameter.
